descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S21 Handoff AI call time and model, ×10 per context

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Handoff AI calls follow 3.5/3.9: timings are targets with 30 s as the upper limit for investigation; each call logs the AI provider's own time separately from the total and which model answered; … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The H-01 (Hospital) and N-01 (Nursing Home) fixtures

When Generate each handoff 10 times through the app's own path

Then Each call returns; durationMs and providerMs are logged per call in aiCallLog (fn assist.generateHandoff) with the model that answered and any fallback

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): reviewOverMs 30000 per call (3.5 investigation limit, Q10): timings are targets, so a call over the limit is flagged for review, never Fail. providerMs missing on a row is a finding (3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took'). The physician's sheet-level wait is recorded in S01 and S10

Where it ran: dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
